title: Correct refraction angle
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be 45°.

title: Correct vertical displacement
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be a numerical multiple of r, approximately 0.73r.

title: Applies Snell's Law correctly
description: Important: The solution correctly applies Snell's law (n = sin(i)/sin(r)) to relate the incident and refracted angles at the edge of the board.

title: Identifies critical angle condition
description: Important: The solution identifies that the limiting condition for part (2) is total internal reflection, and correctly calculates the critical angle sin(C)=1/n.

title: Correct geometric setup
description: Important: The solution establishes the correct right-triangle geometry relating the source depth, board radius, and the critical angle.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution maintains consistent units (e.g., expressing the final displacement in terms of r) and may include a diagram.

title: Misidentifies limiting ray
description: Pitfall: The solution incorrectly assumes the limiting ray for part (2) is the edge ray from part (1), rather than the ray at the critical angle.

title: Trigonometric error
description: Pitfall: The solution makes an error in applying the tangent function (tan(θ) = opposite/adjacent) to the geometry of the problem.
